name: Pepper farms
summary: Inland garden: walk the pepper vines in the morning and see the fresh corns at the farm. The nature account calls the peppercorns aromatic and spicy. The whisper account adds a floral aroma and heat, and pairs the garden with a barrel house. The 3-day account says the island produces over 1,000 tons a year. Go in the morning.
getThere: Inland, on the morning you give the barrel house
heroCaption: Pepper vines trained up poles in a Phú Quốc garden
body: Walk the rows of vines and look at the fresh pepper. Vietnam National Authority of Tourism’s nature account calls the peppercorns aromatic and spicy and lists the farms with the forest and the beaches. The whisper account says chefs prize the black pepper for a floral aroma and heat, and that a morning at an organic farm pairs with a barrel house. The 3-day account calls the pepper pungent and spicy and says the island produces over 1,000 tons a year. The morning is the hour the whisper account uses.

No commune and no garden name is the sight. The visit is the poles, the vines, and the baskets of green corns at the farm house. Keep a brand off the plan. Pair the garden with the fish-sauce vats, then go back to the west-coast sand for the sunset.

figures.caption: Fresh green peppercorns in baskets at a Phú Quốc farm house
figures.alt: Baskets of green peppercorns at a farm house on Phu Quoc

gettingThere: The gardens are inland. Vietnam National Authority of Tourism pairs a morning at a farm with a barrel house. Ask in Dương Đông for a garden that lets you walk the vines, and keep the same morning for the vats.
